name: backup-error-reason
title: A refused backup says why it was refused

issue.title: Backing up into the vault folder fails with a generic message that hides the reason
issue.expected: The status says 'Choose a backup location outside the active vault'.
issue.actual: The status says 'Operation failed. Check destination space, file access and evidence integrity.'
issue.dt_test: tests/desktop/test_ui.py: run MaintenanceWorker (or start_maintenance) with a backup folder inside the vault and assert the message shown contains 'outside the active vault'.
suspected: dt/ui.py: MaintenanceWorker.run replaces every exception with one generic message
